name: Memory
why: What a thread reads and can call at start, each lane held to one metric
ideal: A thread starts with short context, current memory and tools whose source is known, all ready in seconds.

sources.title: Claude Code Docs: How Claude remembers your project
Claude Code Docs: Let Claude coordinate ongoing work with Projects

steps.name: Conversation
steps.rule: Each question to the owner is one decision card with options and a recommendation.

steps.name: Context
steps.rule: The Context tab holds no copy that is older than its repo.

steps.name: Memory
steps.rule: Instructions stay under the limit, and no note outlives the fact it holds.

steps.name: Extensions
steps.rule: Every installed set has a known publisher, and its sign-ins are complete.

steps.name: Connectors
steps.rule: Each installed connector is signed in.

steps.name: Plugins
steps.rule: Every plugin set has a verified listing or an official equivalent, or is named and recorded.
